text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Thai and Russian parliaments support lifting of sanctions on Iraq.
- Arab lawyers demand removal of Iraq sanctions.
- Cyprus denies cancellation of Russian missile deal.
- Symposium on waters in the Arab world to be held in Damascus.
- Wave of explosions continues in Algeria.
- Sudanese President vows not to yield to opposition demands.
- Russian nationalist leader denounces U.S. plans to control oil resources in the Gulf.
- Irrigation ministry starts implementation of the third stage of an irrigation project in the south.
- Turkish newspaper blasts Ankara's policy toward Iraq.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial says reports on Baghdad's hiding of long-range missiles are part of an intelligence ploy to prolong sanctions on Iraq.
